entries.title: The ambient music starts on Cold sleep
entries.body: When you turn on the ambient music without picking a style, it now plays Cold sleep, the soft felt piano, instead of Star cruise. If you already picked a style in Settings → Appearance or asked your first mate for one, it keeps playing that style.
entries.noPicture: The Style choice looks the same; only the style it starts on changed, and Cold sleep's own note already shows it.
